# JSDoc Expert Agent

This project is a specification-first system for mastering and enforcing JSDoc standards.

## Project Structure
- /content: Atomic Markdown pillars (The Specs).
- /.agents/rules/docs-completeness.md: Canonical completeness requirements.
- /.agents/skills/spec-compliance/SKILL.md: Audit workflow and report format.
- /mcp/server.js: MCP server entrypoint (stdio transport).

## Core Pillars
1. Tags: Documentation of all JSDoc tags.
2. Types: Type definition standards.
3. Modules: Module and export conventions.
4. Generics: Template usage standards.

## Agent Instructions
When assisting with JSDoc, use MCP jsdoc_audit (which bundles /content specs at runtime), validate against /.agents/rules/docs-completeness.md, and follow /.agents/skills/spec-compliance/SKILL.md.
